categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of industrial-grade additive manufacturing (3D printing) equipment, including metal selective laser melting (SLM) and polymer selective laser sintering (SLS) devices. It also provides 3D printing materials, software, processes, and related services, serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical, molds, sports footwear, and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary SLM and SLS additive manufacturing equipment, self-developed industrial software systems, control systems, and specialized 3D printing materials. The company has developed advanced multi-laser scanning control, high-precision optical and thermal field design, automated powder spreading, and intelligent manufacturing execution systems. It also innovates in materials like high-strength carbon fiber reinforced PA6 and cold metal fusion technology for titanium alloy parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial users in aerospace, automotive, medical devices, mold manufacturing, sports footwear, consumer electronics, and emerging sectors like low-altitude economy and new energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and exports to over 30 countries globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Changsha, Hunan Province. It has established subsidiaries in the United States (Austin, Texas) and Germany (Stuttgart) to support international sales, technical support, and after-sales services, covering major global markets including North America, Europe, and other overseas regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the additive manufacturing supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of 3D printing equipment, materials, and software. It procures key components such as lasers and galvanometers from international suppliers but produces most other parts domestically. It also provides downstream 3D printing services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in additive manufacturing equipment, materials, and software with emphasis on high efficiency, large size, high precision, and intelligent automation. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on multi-laser systems, advanced materials development, process optimization, and industrial-scale production solutions. It aims to achieve full domestic control of core components and expand applications in aerospace, automotive, medical, and consumer sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of 3D printing equipment and related consumables such as metal and polymer powders. Additional income comes from after-sales services, technical support, and 3D printing service offerings. The company uses a combination of direct sales and channel distribution domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment provider in China and ranks among the top globally. It competes with international firms like EOS, HP, and SLM Solutions but differentiates itself through full proprietary technology integration and a comprehensive product portfolio. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a key player in China's additive manufacturing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 492 million, a decrease of 18.82% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 67.2 million, down 48.76%. Despite revenue decline due to market demand fluctuations, the company increased R&D investment by 20.06% to RMB 98.9 million, representing 20.10% of revenue. Total assets grew by 7.87% to RMB 2.5 billion, reflecting ongoing capacity expansion and capital investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully independent intellectual property system, integrating equipment, software, and materials to provide a complete additive manufacturing solution. Its products feature high precision, large build volumes, multi-laser configurations, and advanced materials tailored for industrial applications. The open and customizable software platform allows clients to optimize processes and reduce costs, supporting scalable industrial production and diverse application needs.
